老孙.d: this old Monkey; yours truly (how Sun Wukong refers to himself)

老猪.d: this old Pig; yours truly (how Zhu Bajie refers to himself)

美猴王.d: Handsome Monkey King (Sun Wukong's first title)

弼马温.d: Protector of the Horses (the menial office Heaven fobs off on Sun Wukong)

太白金星.d: the Gold Star of Venus; Heaven's elderly envoy

女菩萨.d: lady bodhisattva (polite address to a woman)

甚么.d: what; whatever (Ming spelling of 什么)

却说.d: now, the story turns to... (storyteller's transition to a new thread)

四众.d: the four pilgrims; Tripitaka and his three disciples

正果.d: the true fruit; attainment of enlightenment

大雷音寺.d: the Great Thunderclap Monastery; the Buddha's seat, the goal of the journey

东胜神洲.d: Purvavideha, the Eastern Continent (where Flower-Fruit Mountain lies)

西牛贺洲.d: Godaniya, the Western Continent (where the scriptures are)

五庄观.d: the Wuzhuang Temple, home of the ginseng-fruit tree

流沙河.d: the River of Flowing Sands, where Sha Wujing is found

通天河.d: the River That Reaches to Heaven

高老庄.d: Gao Family Village, where Zhu Bajie is found

盘丝洞.d: the Cave of the Silken Web, lair of the spider spirits

觔斗云.d: the somersault cloud, one leap of 108,000 li

如意金箍棒.d: the As-You-Will Gold-Banded Cudgel, Sun Wukong's weapon

九齿钉钯.d: the nine-toothed rake, Zhu Bajie's weapon

紧箍儿.d: the tight-fillet; the golden headband that controls Sun Wukong

锦襕袈裟.d: the brocade cassock given to Tripitaka

幌金绳.d: the Golden Rope, a treasure of the demon kings
